dissent: The control module's reservation_units_are_not_additive=True claim would undercount if control inventory calls are the same scientific units reserved elsewhere; this plan treats every local label as globally additive (conservative), and any future admitted non-additive mapping must revise the ceiling downward rather than silently undercharge.

Option E (inventory controls per gate, outer/retained controls on all 32 shards) is a conservative choice, not a settled requirement; reviewers could defensibly prefer option D (6,266,938 + repeats) or a single-suite floor, but the proposal enumerates all options so the choice is auditable.

The 435,126 reserve does not cover a third gate/sweep or two extra inventory-control commands; expanding coverage beyond the stated envelope requires a new prospective revision rather than silent reserve draws.

findings: All recomputed figures match the supplied design/admission/review values exactly: 44,608 per inventory command, 95,488 explore and 82,048 retained-audit per sweep, 177,536 per sweep, 4,923,418 before controls, 76,582 control margin, 5,220,397 all-additive prospective total, 220,397 over ceiling, 5,012,634 self-contained two-sweep total over by 12,634.

The current 5,000,000 ceiling refuses every complete plan variant: the inventory-control component alone (287,680 including fixture) exceeds the 76,582 margin even if all 27 retained controls were unavailable.
Minimum ceiling if all components are globally additive: 5,220,397 without repeats; 5,230,653 with the controller-required two minimum repeats (2 x 5,128 retained-auditor repeats).
Retained-control charge scales with shard size: (192+35n)x(1+available<=27); 9,296 at 4 histories vs 28,896 at 24 histories; the sourced 9,296 figure understates any plan using 24-history shards.

Proposed conservative ceiling 7,000,000 = 6,564,874 components (option E: inventory controls per gate x2 = 575,360; per-shard outer+retained controls x32 = 1,055,840; min repeats 10,256) + 435,126 explicit unused reserve with stated absorption limits.

The controls durable_plan wrapper_fixture_kernel_calls 4096 is the same units as the command-level planning_fixture_calls reservation; mapped once to resolve the review's double-count/miss risk, pending admitted controller enforcement.

Controller obligations require >=2 repeats duplicating full original accounting, commands list 6..128 entries, and <=8 accounting keys per command; the proposed 102-command plan and 3-key control labels fit those bounds.
limitations: Source-only construction: no campaign Python was imported or executed; all figures are recomputed arithmetic from supplied sources, not measured runtime evidence.
Actual available_retained count per shard (0..27) and real control detection power are unknown without execution; the plan conservatively reserves all 27 available.
No control command is currently executable under the admitted research_entry wrapper (refusing __main__, no callable-injection path); control charges remain prospective reservations only.

The plan remains blocked independent of budget: missing clean candidate, source closure, phase manifests, two fresh Sol xhigh reviews, controller acceptance, and Windows-bound inherited 87-command gates; this document resolves none of those.
The proposed 7,000,000 ceiling is prospective revision text only; the live ceiling remains 5,000,000 and the plan is refused under it.
Time reserves (10,200s finalization, 4,800s gate admission), the 8-point quota reserve, four held unknown-provider reservations, and usage-freshness checks are outside this unit ledger.
